units.zh: 梁書卷第四十四 列傳第三十八
units.en: Book of Liang, Volume 44, Biography 38
units.literal: Book of Liang, Volume 44, Biography 38

units.zh: 太宗十一王 世祖二子
units.en: The eleven sons of Heir Apparent Taizong; the two sons of Emperor Shizu
units.literal: The eleven sons of the Heir Apparent Taizong; the two sons of Emperor Shizu

units.zh: 太宗王皇后生哀太子大器、南郡王大連，陳淑容生尋陽王大心，左夫人生南海王大臨、安陸王大春，謝夫人生瀏陽公大雅，張夫人生新興王大莊，包昭華生西陽王大鈞，范夫人生武寧王大威，褚脩華生建平王大球，陳夫人生義安王大昕，朱夫人生綏建王大摯。
units.en: Empress Wang of Heir Apparent Taizong bore Lamented Crown Prince Daqi and Prince of Nan commandery Dalian; Lady Chen the Shurong bore Prince of Xunyang Daxin; the Left Lady bore Prince Dalin of Nanhai and Prince Dachun of Anlu; Lady Xie bore Duke of Liuyang Daya; Lady Zhang bore Prince of Xinxing Dazhuang; Bao Zhaohua bore Prince of Xiyang Dajun; Lady Fan bore Prince of Wuning Dawei; Chu Xiuhua bore Prince of Jianping Daqiu; Lady Chen bore Prince of Yi'an Daxin; Lady Zhu bore Prince of Suijian Dazhi.
units.literal: Empress Wang of the Heir Apparent Taizong bore the Lamented Crown Prince Daqi, the Prince of Nan commandery Dalian; Lady Chen the Shure gave birth to the Prince of Xunyang Daxin; the left lady bore the Prince of Nanhai Dalin and the Prince of Anlu Dachun; Lady Xie bore the Duke of Liuyang Daya; Lady Zhang bore the Prince of Xinxing Dazhuang; Bao Zhaohua bore the Prince of Xiyang Dajun; Lady Fan bore the Prince of Wuning Dawei; Chu Xiuhua bore the Prince of Jianping Daqiu; Lady Chen bore the Prince of Yi'an Daxin; Lady Zhu bore the Prince of Suijian Dazhi.

units.zh: 自餘諸子，本書不載。
units.en: The remaining sons are not recorded in this book.
units.literal: The remaining sons are not recorded in this book.

units.zh: 尋陽王大心字仁恕。
units.en: Prince of Xunyang Daxin, styled Renshu.
units.literal: The Prince of Xunyang, Daxin, courtesy name Renshu.

units.zh: 幼而聰朗，善屬文。
units.en: From youth he was clever and bright and wrote well.
units.literal: From youth he was clever and bright and skilled at literary composition.

units.zh: 中大通四年，以皇孫封當陽公，邑一千五百戶。
units.en: In the fourth year of Zhongdatong he was enfeoffed Duke of Dangyang with a fief of fifteen hundred households.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Zhongdatong, as imperial grandson he was enfeoffed Duke of Dangyang with a fief of one thousand five hundred households.

units.zh: 大同元年，出爲使持節、都督郢南北司定新五州諸軍事、輕車將軍、郢州刺史。
units.en: In the first year of Great Unity he went out as bearer of the staff, commander of the five E-region prefectures, General of Light Chariots, and inspector of E.
units.literal: In the first year of Great Unity he went out as bearer of the staff, commander of military affairs in the five prefectures of E, north and south of Si, Ding, and Xin, General of Light Chariots, and inspector of E prefecture.

units.zh: 時年十三，太宗以其幼，恐未達民情，戒之曰：「事無大小，悉委行事，纖毫不須措懷。」
units.en: He was thirteen; Taizong, fearing he had not grasped the people's hearts, admonished him, "In affairs great or small, entrust all to your staff—do not let a thread of worry touch your mind."
units.literal: He was thirteen; the Heir Apparent Taizong, because he was young, feared he had not yet grasped the people's hearts and admonished him: "In affairs great or small, entrust all to your staff—do not let a thread of worry touch your mind."

units.zh: 大心雖不親州務，發言每合於理，衆皆驚服。
units.en: Though he did not handle prefectural affairs himself, whenever he spoke it accorded with reason and all were struck and submitted.
units.literal: Though Daxin did not personally handle prefectural affairs, whenever he spoke it accorded with reason and all were struck and submitted.

units.zh: 七年，征爲侍中、兼石頭戍軍事。
units.en: In the seventh year he was summoned as palace attendant and concurrently commander of the Stone City garrison.
units.literal: In the seventh year he was summoned as palace attendant and concurrently commander of the Stone City garrison.

units.zh: 太清元年，出爲雲麾將軍、江州刺史。
units.en: In the first year of Supreme Purity he went out as General of the Cloud Banner and inspector of Jiangzhou.
units.literal: In the first year of Supreme Purity he went out as General of the Cloud Banner and inspector of Jiangzhou.

units.zh: 二年，侯景寇京邑。
units.en: In the second year Hou Jing raided the capital region.
units.literal: In the second year Hou Jing raided the capital region.

units.zh: 大心招集士卒，遠近歸之，衆至數萬，與上流諸軍赴援宮闕。
units.en: Daxin gathered soldiers; men near and far joined until his force reached tens of thousands, and with upriver armies he hurried to relieve the palace.
units.literal: Daxin gathered soldiers; men near and far came to him until his force reached tens of thousands, and with the upriver armies he hurried to relieve the palace.

units.zh: 三年，城陷，上甲侯蕭韶南奔，宣密詔，加散騎常侍，進號平南將軍。
units.en: In the third year the city fell; Marquis of Shangjia Xiao Shao fled south and proclaimed a secret edict making Daxin regular palace attendant and General Who Pacifies the South.
units.literal: In the third year the city fell; Marquis of Shangjia Xiao Shao fled south and proclaimed a secret edict adding Daxin as regular palace attendant and promoting his title to General Who Pacifies the South.

units.zh: 大寶元年，封尋陽王，邑二千戶。
units.en: In the first year of Great Treasure he was enfeoffed Prince of Xunyang with a fief of two thousand households.
units.literal: In the first year of Great Treasure he was enfeoffed Prince of Xunyang with a fief of two thousand households.

units.zh: 初，歷陽太守莊鐵以城降侯景，旣而又奉其母來奔，大心以鐵舊將，厚爲其禮，軍旅之事，悉以委之，仍以爲豫章內史。
units.en: Earlier Liyang magistrate Zhuang Tie had surrendered to Hou Jing, then brought his mother to defect; Daxin, because Tie was an old general, treated him generously and entrusted all military affairs to him, and made him interior minister of Yuzhang.
units.literal: Earlier Liyang magistrate Zhuang Tie had surrendered the city to Hou Jing, then brought his mother to defect; Daxin, because Tie was an old general, treated him with great courtesy and entrusted all military affairs to him, and also made him interior minister of Yuzhang.

units.zh: 侯景數遣軍西上寇抄，大心輒令鐵擊破之，賊不能進。
units.en: Hou Jing repeatedly sent armies west to raid; Daxin always had Tie defeat them and the bandit could not advance.
units.literal: Hou Jing repeatedly sent armies west to raid; Daxin always had Tie defeat them and the bandit could not advance.

units.zh: 時鄱陽王範率衆棄合肥，屯于柵口，待援兵總集，欲俱進。
units.en: The Prince of Poyang Fan had abandoned Hefei and encamped at Zhakou, waiting for relief armies before advancing together.
units.literal: At the time the Prince of Poyang Fan led his host abandoning Hefei and encamped at Zhakou, waiting for relief armies to gather before advancing together.

units.zh: 大心聞之，遣要範西上，以湓城處之，廩饋甚厚，與戮力共除禍難。
units.en: Daxin summoned Fan west, lodged him at Pencheng with rich grain supplies, to join strength against the calamity.
units.literal: Daxin heard and summoned Fan west, lodging him at Pencheng with very rich grain supplies, to join strength in removing the calamity.

units.zh: 會莊鐵據豫章反，大心令中兵參軍韋約等將軍擊之，鐵敗績，又乞降。
units.en: Then Zhuang Tie held Yuzhang in rebellion; Daxin sent middle army aide Wei Yue and others to attack; Tie was defeated and again begged surrender.
units.literal: Then Zhuang Tie held Yuzhang in rebellion; Daxin sent the middle army aide Wei Yue and others with troops to attack; Tie was defeated and again begged surrender.

units.zh: 鄱陽世子嗣先與鐵遊處，因稱其人才略從橫，且舊將也，欲舉大事，當資其力，若降江州，必不全其首領，嗣請援之。
units.en: Poyang's heir Si had traveled with Tie and praised his talent, saying that as an old general he should be used in a great affair; if he surrendered to Jiangzhou his head would not be spared—Si asked to rescue him.
units.literal: The Prince of Poyang's heir Si had earlier traveled with Tie and therefore praised his talent and stratagem, and that as an old general he should be used in a great affair; if he surrendered to Jiangzhou his head would surely not be spared—Si asked to rescue him.

units.zh: 範從之，乃遣將侯瑱率精甲五千往救鐵，夜襲破韋約等營。
units.en: Fan agreed and sent general Hou Zhen with five thousand picked armor to save Tie; by night they stormed and broke Wei Yue's camp.
units.literal: Fan agreed and sent the general Hou Zhen with five thousand picked armor to save Tie; by night they stormed and broke Wei Yue's camp.

units.zh: 大心聞之大懼，於是二籓釁起，人心離貳。
units.en: Daxin heard and was greatly afraid; the two fiefs raised strife and hearts turned divided.
units.literal: Daxin heard and was greatly afraid; then the two fiefs raised strife and hearts turned divided.

units.zh: 景將任約略地至于湓城，大心遣司馬韋質拒戰，敗績。
units.en: Jing's general Ren Yue overran the land to Pencheng; Daxin sent marshal Wei Zhi to meet battle and was defeated.
units.literal: Jing's general Ren Yue overran the land as far as Pencheng; Daxin sent the marshal Wei Zhi to meet battle and was defeated.

units.zh: 時帳下猶有勇士千餘人，咸說曰：「旣無糧儲，難以守固。
units.en: There were still more than a thousand warriors in the tent, who all said, "Without grain stores we cannot hold firm.
units.literal: At the time there were still more than a thousand warriors in the tent, who all said: "Without grain stores we cannot hold firm.

units.zh: 若輕騎往建州，以圖後舉，策之上者也。」
units.en: If with light horse we go to Jianzhou to plan a later rising, that is the best stratagem."
units.literal: If with light horse we go to Jianzhou to plan a later rising, that is the best stratagem."

units.zh: 大心未決，其母陳淑容曰：「卽日聖御年尊，儲宮萬福，汝久奉違顏色，不念拜謁闕庭，且吾已老，而欲遠涉險路，糧儲不給，豈謂孝子？
units.en: Daxin had not decided when his mother Lady Chen said, "Today the sage ruler is old and the heir blessed—you have long been absent and do not think to bow at the palace gate; I am old, and you would cross a perilous road with no grain—can this be filial?
units.literal: Daxin had not decided when his mother Lady Chen the Shure said: "Today the sage ruler is advanced in years and the heir ten thousandfold blessed—you have long been absent from his face and do not think to bow at the palace gate; moreover I am old, and you would cross a perilous road with no grain—can this be called filial?

units.zh: 吾終不行。」
units.en: I will never go."
units.literal: I will never go."

units.zh: 因撫胸慟哭，大心乃止。
units.en: She clutched her breast and wept bitterly; Daxin then stopped.
units.literal: She clutched her breast and wept bitterly; Daxin then stopped.

units.zh: 遂與約和。
units.en: He then made peace with Yue.
units.literal: He then made peace with Yue.

units.zh: 二年秋，遇害，時年二十九。
units.en: In the autumn of the second year he was killed at twenty-nine.
units.literal: In the autumn of the second year he was killed; he was twenty-nine.

units.zh: 南海王大臨，字仁宣。
units.en: Prince of Nanhai Dalin, styled Renxuan.
units.literal: The Prince of Nanhai, Dalin, courtesy name Renxuan.

units.zh: 大同二年，封寧國縣公，邑一千五百戶。
units.en: In the second year of Great Unity he was enfeoffed Duke of Ningguo with fifteen hundred households.
units.literal: In the second year of Great Unity he was enfeoffed Duke of Ningguo with a fief of one thousand five hundred households.

units.zh: 少而敏慧。
units.en: From youth he was quick and clever.
units.literal: From youth he was quick and clever.

units.zh: 年十一，遭左夫人憂，哭泣毀瘠，以孝聞。
units.en: At eleven he mourned the left lady, wept until wasted, and was famed for filial piety.
units.literal: At eleven he suffered mourning for the left lady; he wept until wasted and was famed for filial piety.

units.zh: 後入國學，明經射策甲科，拜中書侍郎，遷給事黃門侍郎。
units.en: Later he entered the National University, placed first in classics and policy, became Gentleman of the Palace Secretariat, and rose to Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate.
units.literal: Later he entered the National University, placed first in the classics examination and policy shooting, was made gentleman of the Secretariat, and promoted to gentleman in the Yellow Gate.

units.zh: 十一年，爲長兼侍中。
units.en: In the eleventh year he was made acting long-term palace attendant.
units.literal: In the eleventh year he was made acting long-term palace attendant.

units.zh: 出爲輕車將軍，琅邪、彭城二郡太守。
units.en: He went out as General of Light Chariots and magistrate of Langye and Pengcheng.
units.literal: He went out as General of Light Chariots and magistrate of Langye and Pengcheng commanderies.

units.zh: 侯景亂，爲使持節、宣惠將軍，屯新亭。
units.en: When Hou Jing rebelled he was made bearer of the staff and General of Proclaimed Grace, encamped at Xinting.
units.literal: When Hou Jing rebelled he was made bearer of the staff and General of Proclaimed Grace, encamped at Xinting.

units.zh: 俄又徵還，屯端門，都督城南諸軍事。
units.en: Soon he was summoned back to garrison the Duan Gate and command military affairs south of the city.
units.literal: Soon he was summoned back to garrison the Duan Gate and command military affairs south of the city.

units.zh: 時議者皆勸收外財物，擬供賞賜，大臨獨曰：「物乃賞士，而牛可犒軍。」
units.en: Men of the day urged seizing outside goods for rewards; Dalin alone said, "Goods reward warriors—but cattle can feed the army."
units.literal: Men of the day all urged seizing outside goods to supply rewards; Dalin alone said: "Goods are for rewarding warriors—but cattle can feed the army."

units.zh: 命取牛，得千餘頭，城內賴以饗士。
units.en: He ordered cattle taken and got more than a thousand head; the city relied on this to feast the troops.
units.literal: He ordered cattle taken and got more than a thousand head; within the city they relied on this to feast the troops.

units.zh: 大寶元年，封南海郡王，邑二千戶。
units.en: In the first year of Great Treasure he was enfeoffed Prince of Nanhai with two thousand households.
units.literal: In the first year of Great Treasure he was enfeoffed Prince of Nanhai commandery with a fief of two thousand households.

units.zh: 出爲使持節、都督揚、南徐二州諸軍事、安南將軍、揚州刺史。
units.en: He went out as bearer of the staff, commander of Yang and South Xu, General Who Pacifies the South, and inspector of Yangzhou.
units.literal: He went out as bearer of the staff, commander of military affairs in Yang and South Xu prefectures, General Who Pacifies the South, and inspector of Yangzhou.

units.zh: 又除安東將軍、吳郡太守。
units.en: He was also made General Who Pacifies the East and magistrate of Wu commandery.
units.literal: He was also made General Who Pacifies the East and magistrate of Wu commandery.

units.zh: 時張彪起義於會稽，吳人陸令公、潁川庾孟卿等勸大臨走投彪。
units.en: Zhang Biao raised righteousness in Kuaiji; Wu men Lu Linggong and Yingchuan Yu Mengqing urged Dalin to flee to Biao.
units.literal: At the time Zhang Biao raised righteousness in Kuaiji; Wu men Lu Linggong and Yingchuan Yu Mengqing and others urged Dalin to flee to Biao.

units.zh: 大臨曰：「彪若成功，不資我力；
units.en: Dalin said, "If Biao succeeds, he will not need my strength;
units.literal: Dalin said: "If Biao succeeds, he will not need my strength;

units.zh: 如其撓敗，以我說焉。
units.en: if he is broken and defeated, they will blame my persuasion.
units.literal: if he is broken and defeated, they will blame it on my persuasion.

units.zh: 不可往也。」
units.en: I cannot go."
units.literal: I cannot go."

units.zh: 二年秋，遇害于郡，時年二十五。
units.en: In the autumn of the second year he was killed in the commandery at twenty-five.
units.literal: In the autumn of the second year he was killed in the commandery; he was twenty-five.

units.zh: 南郡王大連，字仁靖。
units.en: Prince of Nan commandery Dalian, styled Renjing.
units.literal: The Prince of Nan commandery, Dalian, courtesy name Renjing.

units.zh: 少俊爽，能屬文，舉止風流，雅有巧思，妙達音樂，兼善丹青。
units.en: From youth handsome and bright, he wrote well, bore himself gracefully, had a gift for design, mastered music, and painted well.
units.literal: From youth handsome and bright, skilled at literary composition, his bearing and carriage graceful; he had a subtle gift for design, was masterly in music, and also good at painting.

units.zh: 大同二年，封臨城縣公，邑一千五百戶。
units.en: In the second year of Great Unity he was enfeoffed Duke of Lincheng with fifteen hundred households.
units.literal: In the second year of Great Unity he was enfeoffed Duke of Lincheng with a fief of one thousand five hundred households.

units.zh: 七年，與南海王俱入國學，射策甲科，拜中書侍郎。
units.en: In the seventh year he and the Prince of Nanhai together entered the National University, placed first in policy, and became Gentlemen of the Palace Secretariat.
units.literal: In the seventh year he and the Prince of Nanhai together entered the National University, placed first in policy shooting, and were made gentlemen of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 十年，高祖幸朱方，大連與兄大臨並從。
units.en: In the tenth year the Founding Emperor visited Zhufang; Dalian and his brother Dalin both followed.
units.literal: In the tenth year the Founding Emperor visited Zhufang; Dalian and his elder brother Dalin both followed.

units.zh: 高祖問曰：「汝等習騎不？」
units.en: The Founding Emperor asked, "Have you practiced riding?"
units.literal: The Founding Emperor asked: "Have you practiced riding?"

units.zh: 對曰：「臣等未奉詔，不敢輒習。」
units.en: They answered, "We have not received edict and dare not practice on our own."
units.literal: They answered: "We have not received edict and dare not practice on our own."

units.zh: 敕各給馬試之，大連兄弟據鞍往還，各得馳驟之節，高祖大悅，卽賜所乘馬。
units.en: He ordered each given a horse; the brothers mounted and circled, each showing the rhythm of the gallop; the Founding Emperor was greatly pleased and gave them the horses they rode.
units.literal: He ordered each given a horse to try; the Dalian brothers mounted and circled, each showing the rhythm of the gallop; the Founding Emperor was greatly pleased and at once gave them the horses they rode.

units.zh: 及爲啓謝，詞又甚美。
units.en: When they memorialized thanks the wording was also very fine.
units.literal: When they memorialized thanks the wording was also very fine.

units.zh: 高祖佗日謂太宗曰：「昨見大臨、大連，風韻可愛，足以慰吾年老。」
units.en: Another day the Founding Emperor said to Taizong, "Yesterday seeing Dalin and Dalian—their bearing is lovable and enough to comfort me in my old age."
units.literal: Another day the Founding Emperor said to the Heir Apparent Taizong: "Yesterday seeing Dalin and Dalian—their bearing is lovable and enough to comfort me in my old age."

units.zh: 遷給事黃門侍郎，轉侍中，尋兼石頭戍軍事。
units.en: He rose to Yellow Gate gentleman, then palace attendant, soon concurrently commander of the Stone City garrison.
units.literal: He was promoted to gentleman in the Yellow Gate, then palace attendant, soon concurrently commander of the Stone City garrison.

units.zh: 太清元年，出爲使持節、輕車將軍、東揚州刺史。
units.en: In the first year of Supreme Purity he went out as bearer of the staff, General of Light Chariots, and inspector of East Yangzhou.
units.literal: In the first year of Supreme Purity he went out as bearer of the staff, General of Light Chariots, and inspector of East Yangzhou.

units.zh: 侯景入寇京師，大連率衆四萬來赴。
units.en: When Hou Jing invaded the capital Dalian led forty thousand men to the rescue.
units.literal: When Hou Jing invaded the capital Dalian led forty thousand men to the rescue.

units.zh: 及臺城沒，援軍散，復還揚州。
units.en: When the terrace city fell the relief armies scattered and he returned to Yangzhou.
units.literal: When the terrace city fell the relief armies scattered and he returned to Yangzhou.

units.zh: 三年，會稽山賊田領群聚黨數萬來攻，大連命中兵參軍張彪擊斬之。
units.en: In the third year Kuaiji bandits led by Tian Lingqun gathered tens of thousands and attacked; Dalian ordered middle army aide Zhang Biao to strike and behead them.
units.literal: In the third year bandits of Kuaiji led by Tian Ling gathered tens of thousands in party and attacked; Dalian ordered the middle army aide Zhang Biao to strike and behead them.

units.zh: 大寶元年，封爲南郡王，邑二千戶。
units.en: In the first year of Great Treasure he was enfeoffed Prince of Nan commandery with two thousand households.
units.literal: In the first year of Great Treasure he was enfeoffed Prince of Nan commandery with a fief of two thousand households.

units.zh: 景仍遣其將趙伯超、劉神茂來討，大連設備以待之。
units.en: Jing again sent generals Zhao Bochao and Liu Shenmao to attack; Dalian prepared to await them.
units.literal: Jing again sent his generals Zhao Bochao and Liu Shenmao to attack; Dalian made preparations to await them.

units.zh: 會將留異以城應賊，大連棄城走，至信安，爲賊所獲。
units.en: Then general Liu Yi surrendered the city to the bandit; Dalian abandoned the city and fled; at Xin'an he was taken.
units.literal: Then the general Liu Yi surrendered the city to the bandit; Dalian abandoned the city and fled; reaching Xin'an he was taken by the bandit.

units.zh: 侯景以爲輕車將軍、行揚州事，遷平南將軍、江州刺史。
units.en: Hou Jing made him General of Light Chariots with acting charge of Yangzhou, then General Who Pacifies the South and inspector of Jiangzhou.
units.literal: Hou Jing made him General of Light Chariots with acting charge of Yangzhou affairs, then promoted to General Who Pacifies the South and inspector of Jiangzhou.

units.zh: 大連旣迫寇手，恒思逃竄，乃與賊約曰：「軍民之事，吾不預焉。
units.en: Pressed in the bandit's grip, Dalian always thought of escape and made a pact, "In military and civil affairs I take no part.
units.literal: Dalian, pressed in the bandit's grip, always thought of escape, and made a pact with the bandit: "In military and civil affairs I take no part.

units.zh: 候我存亡，但聽鐘響。」
units.en: Wait for my life or death—only listen for the bell."
units.literal: Wait for my life or death—only listen for the bell."

units.zh: 欲簡與相見，因得亡逸，賊亦信之。
units.en: He wished to meet the bandit with few attendants and slip away; the bandit also trusted him.
units.literal: He wished to meet the bandit with few attendants and thus slip away; the bandit also trusted him.

units.zh: 事未果。
units.en: The affair did not succeed.
units.literal: The affair did not succeed.

units.zh: 二年秋，遇害，時年二十五。
units.en: In the autumn of the second year he was killed at twenty-five.
units.literal: In the autumn of the second year he was killed; he was twenty-five.

units.zh: 安陸王大春，字仁經。
units.en: Prince of Anlu Dachun, styled Renjing.
units.literal: The Prince of Anlu, Dachun, courtesy name Renjing.

units.zh: 少博涉書記。
units.en: From youth he read widely in letters and records.
units.literal: From youth he read widely in letters and records.

units.zh: 天性孝謹，體貌環偉，腰帶十圍。
units.en: By nature filial and careful, his build imposing, his belt ten arm-spans around.
units.literal: By nature filial and careful, his build round and imposing, his belt ten arm-spans around.

units.zh: 大同六年，封西豊縣公，邑一千五百戶。
units.en: In the sixth year of Great Unity he was enfeoffed Duke of Xifeng with fifteen hundred households.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Great Unity he was enfeoffed Duke of Xifeng with a fief of one thousand five hundred households.

units.zh: 拜中書侍郎。
units.en: He was made Secretariat gentleman.
units.literal: He was made gentleman of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 後爲寧遠將軍，知石頭戍軍事。
units.en: Later he was General of Peaceful Distance and in charge of Stone City garrison affairs.
units.literal: Later he was General of Peaceful Distance and in charge of Stone City garrison affairs.

units.zh: 侯景內寇，大春奔京口，隨邵陵王入援，戰于鐘山，爲賊所獲。
units.en: When Hou Jing invaded Dachun fled to Jingkou and followed the Prince of Shaoling to the rescue, fought at Zhongshan, and was taken.
units.literal: When Hou Jing invaded within the passes Dachun fled to Jingkou and followed the Prince of Shaoling to the rescue, fought at Zhongshan, and was taken by the bandit.

units.zh: 京城旣陷，大寶元年，封安陸郡王，邑二千戶。
units.en: When the capital fell, in the first year of Great Treasure he was enfeoffed Prince of Anlu with two thousand households.
units.literal: When the capital fell, in the first year of Great Treasure he was enfeoffed Prince of Anlu commandery with a fief of two thousand households.

units.zh: 出爲使持節、雲麾將軍、東揚州刺史。
units.en: He went out as bearer of the staff, General of the Cloud Banner, and inspector of East Yangzhou.
units.literal: He went out as bearer of the staff, General of the Cloud Banner, and inspector of East Yangzhou.

units.zh: 二年秋，遇害，時年二十二。
units.en: In the autumn of the second year he was killed at twenty-two.
units.literal: In the autumn of the second year he was killed; he was twenty-two.

units.zh: 瀏陽公大雅字仁風。
units.en: Duke of Liuyang Daya, styled Renfeng.
units.literal: The Duke of Liuyang, Daya, courtesy name Renfeng.

units.zh: 大同九年，封瀏陽縣公，邑一千五百戶。
units.en: In the ninth year of Great Unity he was enfeoffed Duke of Liuyang with fifteen hundred households.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Great Unity he was enfeoffed Duke of Liuyang with a fief of one thousand five hundred households.

units.zh: 少聰警，美姿儀，特爲高祖所愛。
units.en: From youth clever and handsome, he was especially loved by the Founding Emperor.
units.literal: From youth clever and alert, handsome in bearing, he was especially loved by the Founding Emperor.

units.zh: 太清三年，京城陷，賊已乘城，大雅猶命左右格戰，賊至漸衆，乃自縋而下。
units.en: In the third year of Supreme Purity the capital fell; the bandit had scaled the wall, yet Daya still ordered his men to fight; the bandit grew numerous and he lowered himself by rope.
units.literal: In the third year of Supreme Purity the capital fell; the bandit had already scaled the wall, yet Daya still ordered his attendants to fight at the barrier; the bandit grew numerous and he lowered himself by rope.

units.zh: 因發憤感疾，薨，時年十七。
units.en: He then fell ill from indignation and died at seventeen.
units.literal: He then fell ill from indignation and died; he was seventeen.

units.zh: 新興王大莊，字仁禮。
units.en: Prince of Xinxing Dazhuang, styled Renli.
units.literal: The Prince of Xinxing, Dazhuang, courtesy name Renli.

units.zh: 大同九年，封高唐縣公，邑一千五百戶。
units.en: In the ninth year of Great Unity he was enfeoffed Duke of Gaotang with fifteen hundred households.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Great Unity he was enfeoffed Duke of Gaotang with a fief of one thousand five hundred households.

units.zh: 大寶元年，封新興郡王，邑二千戶。
units.en: In the first year of Great Treasure he was enfeoffed Prince of Xinxing with two thousand households.
units.literal: In the first year of Great Treasure he was enfeoffed Prince of Xinxing commandery with a fief of two thousand households.

units.zh: 出爲使持節、都督南徐州諸軍事、宣毅將軍、南徐州刺史。
units.en: He went out as bearer of the staff, commander of South Xuzhou, General of Firm Resolve, and inspector of South Xuzhou.
units.literal: He went out as bearer of the staff, commander of military affairs in South Xuzhou, General of Firm Resolve, and inspector of South Xuzhou.

units.zh: 二年秋，遇害，時年十八。
units.en: In the autumn of the second year he was killed at eighteen.
units.literal: In the autumn of the second year he was killed; he was eighteen.

units.zh: 西陽王大鈞字仁輔。
units.en: Prince of Xiyang Dajun, styled Renfu.
units.literal: The Prince of Xiyang, Dajun, courtesy name Renfu.

units.zh: 性厚重，不妄戲弄。
units.en: By nature grave and steady, he did not play rashly.
units.literal: By nature grave and steady, he did not play rashly.

units.zh: 年七歲，高祖嘗問讀何書，對曰「學《詩》」。
units.en: At seven the Founding Emperor asked what book he read; he answered, "Studying the Odes."
units.literal: At seven the Founding Emperor once asked what book he was reading; he answered: "Studying the Odes."

units.zh: 因命諷誦，音韻清雅，高祖因賜王羲之書一卷。
units.en: Ordered to recite, his tones were clear and elegant, and the Founding Emperor gave him one scroll of Wang Xizhi's calligraphy.
units.literal: He was then ordered to recite; his tones were clear and elegant, and the Founding Emperor gave him one scroll of Wang Xizhi's calligraphy.

units.zh: 大寶元年，封西陽郡王，邑二千戶。
units.en: In the first year of Great Treasure he was enfeoffed Prince of Xiyang with two thousand households.
units.literal: In the first year of Great Treasure he was enfeoffed Prince of Xiyang commandery with a fief of two thousand households.

units.zh: 出爲宣惠將軍、丹陽尹。
units.en: He went out as General of Proclaimed Grace and governor of Danyang.
units.literal: He went out as General of Proclaimed Grace and governor of Danyang.

units.zh: 二年，監揚州，將軍如故。
units.en: In the second year he supervised Yangzhou, keeping his general's title.
units.literal: In the second year he supervised Yangzhou, general as before.

units.zh: 至秋遇害，時年十三。
units.en: By autumn he was killed at thirteen.
units.literal: By autumn he was killed; he was thirteen.

units.zh: 武寧王大威字仁容。
units.en: Prince of Wuning Dawei, styled Renrong.
units.literal: The Prince of Wuning, Dawei, courtesy name Renrong.

units.zh: 美風儀，眉目如畫。
units.en: Handsome in bearing, brows and eyes like a painting.
units.literal: Handsome in bearing, his brows and eyes like a painting.

units.zh: 大寶元年，封武寧郡王，邑二千戶。
units.en: In the first year of Great Treasure he was enfeoffed Prince of Wuning with two thousand households.
units.literal: In the first year of Great Treasure he was enfeoffed Prince of Wuning commandery with a fief of two thousand households.

units.zh: 二年，出爲信威將軍、丹陽尹。
units.en: In the second year he went out as General of Trusted Might and governor of Danyang.
units.literal: In the second year he went out as General of Trusted Might and governor of Danyang.

units.zh: 其年秋，遇害，時年十三。
units.en: That autumn he was killed at thirteen.
units.literal: That autumn he was killed; he was thirteen.

units.zh: 建平王大球字仁珽。
units.en: Prince of Jianping Daqiu, styled Renting.
units.literal: The Prince of Jianping, Daqiu, courtesy name Renting.

units.zh: 大寶元年，封建平郡王，邑二千戶。
units.en: In the first year of Great Treasure he was enfeoffed Prince of Jianping with two thousand households.
units.literal: In the first year of Great Treasure he was enfeoffed Prince of Jianping commandery with a fief of two thousand households.

units.zh: 性明慧夙成。
units.en: By nature bright and clever from early youth.
units.literal: By nature bright and clever from early youth.

units.zh: 初，侯景圍京城，高祖素歸心釋教，每發誓願，恒云：「若有衆生應受諸苦，悉衍身代當。」
units.en: When Hou Jing besieged the capital, the Founding Emperor had long turned to Buddhism; whenever he vowed he said, "If living beings should suffer every pain, let it all pass to my body in their stead."
units.literal: Earlier, when Hou Jing besieged the capital, the Founding Emperor had long turned his heart to Buddhism; whenever he made a vow he always said: "If there are living beings who should suffer every pain, let it all be transferred to my body in their stead."

units.zh: 時大球年甫七歲，聞而驚謂母曰：「官家尚爾，兒安敢辭？」
units.en: Daqiu was just seven; hearing this he said to his mother, "If the ruler is still like this, how dare I refuse?"
units.literal: Daqiu was just seven; hearing this he was startled and said to his mother: "If the ruler is still like this, how dare I refuse?"

units.zh: 乃六時禮佛，亦云：「凡有衆生應獲苦報，悉大球代受。」
units.en: He worshiped Buddha at the six hours and said, "Whatever living beings should receive bitter retribution, let Daqiu receive it all in their stead."
units.literal: He then worshiped Buddha at the six hours and likewise said: "Whatever living beings should receive bitter retribution, let Daqiu receive it all in their stead."

units.zh: 其早慧如此。
units.en: Such was his early wisdom.
units.literal: Such was his early wisdom.

units.zh: 二年，出爲輕車將軍、兼石頭戍軍事。
units.en: In the second year he went out as General of Light Chariots and concurrently commander of the Stone City garrison.
units.literal: In the second year he went out as General of Light Chariots and concurrently commander of the Stone City garrison.

units.zh: 其年秋，遇害，時年十一。
units.en: That autumn he was killed at eleven.
units.literal: That autumn he was killed; he was eleven.

units.zh: 義安王大昕，字仁朗。
units.en: Prince Daxin of Yi'an was styled Renlang.
units.literal: Prince Daxin of Yi'an was styled Renlang.

units.zh: 年四歲，母陳夫人卒，便哀慕毀悴，有若成人。
units.en: When he was four, his mother, Lady Chen, died; he grieved and wasted away in longing, as though he were an adult.
units.literal: When he was four, his mother, Lady Chen, died; he grieved and wasted away in longing, as though he were an adult.

units.zh: 及高祖崩，大昕奉慰太宗，嗚咽不能自勝。
units.en: When Gaozu died, Daxin offered consolation to Taizong, sobbing so hard he could not control himself.
units.literal: When Gaozu died, Daxin offered consolation to Taizong, sobbing so hard he could not control himself.

units.zh: 左右見之，莫不掩泣。
units.en: Those attending at the sides saw him, and none failed to cover their faces and weep.
units.literal: Those attending at the sides saw him, and none failed to cover their faces and weep.

units.zh: 大寶元年，封義安郡王，邑二千戶。
units.en: In Dabao 1, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Yi'an Commandery with a fief of two thousand households.
units.literal: In Dabao 1, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Yi'an Commandery with a fief of two thousand households.

units.zh: 二年，出爲寧遠將軍、琅邪、彭城二郡太守，未之鎮，遇害，時年十一。
units.en: In the second year, he went out as General of Peaceful Distance and administrator of Langye and Pengcheng commanderies, but before reaching his post he was killed, aged eleven.
units.literal: In the second year, he went out as General Who Pacifies the Distant and administrator of Langye and Pengcheng commanderies, but before reaching his post he was killed, aged eleven.

units.zh: 綏建王大摯，字仁瑛。
units.en: Prince of Suijian Dazhi, styled Renying.
units.literal: The Prince of Suijian, Dazhi, courtesy name Renying.

units.zh: 幼雄壯有膽氣，及京城陷，乃歎曰：「大丈夫會當滅虜屬。」
units.en: From youth bold with martial spirit; when the capital fell he sighed, "A great man ought to destroy these bandit slaves."
units.literal: From youth bold and strong with martial spirit; when the capital fell he sighed: "A great man ought to destroy these bandit slaves."

units.zh: 奶媼驚，掩其口曰：「勿妄言，禍將及！」
units.en: His nurse covered his mouth in alarm, "Do not speak rashly—calamity will come!"
units.literal: His nurse in alarm covered his mouth: "Do not speak rashly—calamity will come!"

units.zh: 大摯笑曰：「禍至非由此言。」
units.en: Dazhi laughed, "Calamity will not come from these words."
units.literal: Dazhi laughed: "Calamity will not come from these words."

units.zh: 大寶元年，封綏建郡王，邑二千戶。
units.en: In the first year of Great Treasure he was enfeoffed Prince of Suijian with two thousand households.
units.literal: In the first year of Great Treasure he was enfeoffed Prince of Suijian commandery with a fief of two thousand households.

units.zh: 二年，爲寧遠將軍，遇害，時年十歲。
units.en: In the second year he was General of Peaceful Distance and was killed at ten.
units.literal: In the second year he was General of Peaceful Distance and was killed; he was ten.

units.zh: 世祖諸男：徐妃生忠壯世子方等，王夫人生貞惠世子方諸，其愍懷太子方矩
units.en: Emperor Shizu's sons: Lady Xu bore Loyal and Upright Heir Fang Deng; Lady Wang bore Upright and Gracious Heir Fang Zhu; Lamented and Cherished Crown Prince Fang Ju
units.literal: The sons of Emperor Shizu: Lady Xu bore the Loyal and Upright Heir Fang Deng; Lady Wang bore the Upright and Gracious Heir Fang Zhu; the Lamented and Cherished Crown Prince Fang Ju

units.zh: 〈（本書不載所生，別有傳）〉，
units.en: (His birth mother is not recorded in this book; he has a separate biography.)
units.literal: (his birth mother is not recorded in this book; he has a separate biography)〉

units.zh: 夏賢妃生敬皇帝。
units.en: Lady Xia the Worthy bore Emperor Jing.
units.literal: Lady Xia the Worthy bore Emperor Jing.

units.zh: 自餘諸子，並本書無傳。
units.en: The remaining sons have no biography in this book.
units.literal: The remaining sons all have no biography in this book.

units.zh: 忠壯世子方等，字實相，世祖長子也。
units.en: Loyal and Upright Heir Fang Deng, styled Shixiang, was Emperor Shizu's eldest son.
units.literal: The Loyal and Upright Heir Fang Deng, courtesy name Shixiang, was the eldest son of Emperor Shizu.

units.zh: 母曰徐妃。
units.en: His mother was Lady Xu.
units.literal: His mother was Lady Xu.

units.zh: 少聰敏，有俊才，善騎射，尤長巧思。
units.en: From youth clever and keen, with outstanding talent, skilled at riding and shooting, especially gifted in ingenious design.
units.literal: From youth clever and keen, with outstanding talent, skilled at riding and shooting, especially gifted in ingenious design.

units.zh: 性愛林泉，特好散逸。
units.en: By nature he loved forests and springs and favored untrammeled wandering.
units.literal: By nature he loved forests and springs and especially favored untrammeled wandering.

units.zh: 嘗著論曰：「人生處世，如白駒過隙耳。
units.en: He once wrote, "Life in the world is like a white colt crossing a crack.
units.literal: He once composed a discourse saying: "Life in the world is like a white colt crossing a crack.

units.zh: 一壺之酒，足以養性；
units.en: One jug of wine is enough to nurture the nature;
units.literal: One jug of wine is enough to nurture the nature;

units.zh: 一簞之食，足以怡形。
units.en: one basket of food is enough to delight the form.
units.literal: one basket of food is enough to delight the form.

units.zh: 生在蓬蒿，死葬溝壑，瓦棺石槨，何以異茲？
units.en: Born among weeds, buried in ditches—how do tile coffin and stone outer coffin differ?
units.literal: Born among weeds, buried in ditches—how do tile coffin and stone outer coffin differ from this?

units.zh: 吾嘗夢爲魚，因化爲鳥。
units.en: I once dreamed I was a fish and then became a bird.
units.literal: I once dreamed I was a fish and then transformed into a bird.

units.zh: 當其夢也，何樂如之；
units.en: While dreaming, what joy could match it;
units.literal: While dreaming, what joy could match it;

units.zh: 及其覺也，何憂斯類；
units.en: when I awoke, what sorrow of that kind;
units.literal: when I awoke, what sorrow of that kind;

units.zh: 良由吾之不及魚鳥者，遠矣。
units.en: truly because I fall far short of fish and birds.
units.literal: truly because I fall far short of fish and birds.

units.zh: 故魚鳥飛浮，任其志性；
units.en: Thus fish and birds fly and float, following their nature and will;
units.literal: Thus fish and birds fly and float, following their nature and will;

units.zh: 吾之進退，恒存掌握。
units.en: my advance and retreat always rest in another's grasp.
units.literal: my advance and retreat always rest in another's grasp.

units.zh: 舉手懼觸，搖足恐墮。
units.en: Raising a hand I fear to touch; moving a foot I fear to fall.
units.literal: Raising a hand I fear to touch; moving a foot I fear to fall.

units.zh: 若使吾終得與魚鳥同遊，則去人間如脫屣耳。」
units.en: If I could roam with fish and birds at last, leaving the human world would be like doffing shoes."
units.literal: If I could at last roam with fish and birds, leaving the human world would be like doffing shoes."

units.zh: 初，徐妃以嫉妒失寵，方等意不自安。
units.en: Earlier Lady Xu had lost favor through jealousy; Fang Deng felt ill at ease.
units.literal: Earlier Lady Xu had lost favor through jealousy; Fang Deng felt ill at ease.

units.zh: 世祖聞之，又惡方等，方等益懼，故述論以申其志焉。
units.en: Shizu heard and also disliked Fang Deng; he grew more afraid and set forth this discourse to declare his intent.
units.literal: Emperor Shizu heard and also disliked Fang Deng; Fang Deng grew more afraid and therefore set forth this discourse to declare his intent.

units.zh: 會高祖欲見諸王長子，世祖遣方等入侍，方等欣然升舟，冀免憂辱。
units.en: When the Founding Emperor wished to see princes' eldest sons, Shizu sent Fang Deng to attend; he gladly boarded the boat, hoping to escape worry and disgrace.
units.literal: When the Founding Emperor wished to see the eldest sons of the princes, Shizu sent Fang Deng to attend; Fang Deng gladly boarded the boat, hoping to escape worry and disgrace.

units.zh: 行至繇水，值侯景亂，世祖召之，方等啓曰：「昔申生不愛其死，方等豈顧其生？」
units.en: Reaching Yaoshui he met Hou Jing's rebellion; Shizu summoned him; Fang Deng memorialized, "Formerly Shensheng did not love his life—how would I cherish mine?"
units.literal: Reaching Yaoshui he met Hou Jing's rebellion; Shizu summoned him; Fang Deng memorialized: "Formerly Shensheng did not love his life—how would Fang Deng cherish his?"

units.zh: 世祖省書歎息，知無還意，乃配步騎一萬，使援京都。
units.en: Shizu read the letter, sighed, knew he had no mind to return, and assigned him ten thousand foot and horse to relieve the capital.
units.literal: Shizu read the letter, sighed, knew he had no mind to return, and assigned him ten thousand foot and horse to relieve the capital.

units.zh: 賊每來攻，方等必身當矢石。
units.en: Whenever the bandit attacked Fang Deng always met arrows and stones in person.
units.literal: Whenever the bandit came to attack Fang Deng always met arrows and stones in person.

units.zh: 宮城陷，方等歸荊州，收集士馬，甚得衆和，世祖始歎其能。
units.en: When the palace city fell he returned to Jingzhou, gathered soldiers and horses, and won great harmony among the host—Shizu then sighed at his ability.
units.literal: When the palace city fell Fang Deng returned to Jingzhou, gathered soldiers and horses, and won great harmony among the host—Shizu then sighed at his ability.

units.zh: 方等又勸修築城柵，以備不虞。
units.en: He also urged building walls and palisades against the unforeseen.
units.literal: Fang Deng also urged building walls and palisades against the unforeseen.

units.zh: 旣成，樓雉相望，周回七十餘里。
units.en: When finished, towers and battlements faced one another for more than seventy li.
units.literal: When finished, towers and battlements faced one another, the circuit more than seventy li.

units.zh: 世祖觀之甚悅，入謂徐妃曰：「若更有一子如此，吾復何憂！」
units.en: Shizu viewed it with great pleasure and said to Lady Xu, "If I had another son like this, what more would I worry about!"
units.literal: Shizu viewed it with great pleasure, entered and said to Lady Xu: "If I had another son like this, what more would I worry about!"

units.zh: 徐妃不答，垂泣而退。
units.en: Lady Xu did not answer, wept, and withdrew.
units.literal: Lady Xu did not answer, wept, and withdrew.

units.zh: 世祖忿之，因疏其穢行，榜於大閣。
units.en: Shizu in anger set forth her shameful conduct and posted it on the great gate.
units.literal: Shizu in anger therefore set forth her shameful conduct and posted it on the great gate.

units.zh: 方等入見，益以自危。
units.en: Fang Deng came to audience and felt still more endangered.
units.literal: Fang Deng came to audience and felt still more endangered.

units.zh: 時河東王爲湘州刺史，不受督府之令，方等乃乞征之，世祖許焉。
units.en: The Prince of Hedong was inspector of Xiangzhou and did not accept headquarters orders; Fang Deng begged to campaign against him and Shizu granted it.
units.literal: At the time the Prince of Hedong was inspector of Xiangzhou and did not accept the headquarters' orders; Fang Deng begged to campaign against him and Shizu granted it.

units.zh: 拜爲都督，令帥精卒二萬南討。
units.en: He was made commander and ordered to lead twenty thousand picked troops south.
units.literal: He was made commander and ordered to lead twenty thousand picked troops south to attack.

units.zh: 方等臨行，謂所親曰：「吾此段出征，必死無二；
units.en: Setting out he told those close to him, "On this campaign I shall surely die without second thought;
units.literal: As Fang Deng set out he told those close to him: "On this campaign I shall surely die without second thought;

units.zh: 死而獲所，吾豈愛生。」
units.en: if in death I gain my aim, how would I love life."
units.literal: if in death I gain my aim, how would I love life."

units.zh: 及至麻溪，河東王率軍逆戰，方等擊之，軍敗，遂溺死，時年二十二。
units.en: Reaching Maxi, the Prince of Hedong met him in battle; Fang Deng attacked; the army was defeated and he drowned at twenty-two.
units.literal: Reaching Maxi, the Prince of Hedong led his army to meet battle; Fang Deng attacked; the army was defeated and he drowned; he was twenty-two.

units.zh: 世祖聞之，不以爲慼。
units.en: Shizu heard and did not grieve.
units.literal: Shizu heard and did not grieve.

units.zh: 後追思其才，贈侍中、中軍將軍、揚州刺史，諡曰忠壯世子，幷爲招魂以哀之。
units.en: Later, recalling his talent, he posthumously made him palace attendant, central army commander, and inspector of Yangzhou, titled Loyal and Upright Heir, and performed a soul-summoning rite to mourn him.
units.literal: Later, recalling his talent, he posthumously made him palace attendant, central army commander, and inspector of Yangzhou, titled Loyal and Upright Heir, and also performed a soul-summoning rite to mourn him.

units.zh: 方等注范曄《後漢書》，未就；
units.en: He annotated Fan Ye's Book of Later Han but did not finish;
units.literal: Fang Deng annotated Fan Ye's Book of Later Han but did not finish;

units.zh: 所撰《三十國春秋》及《靜住子》，行於世。
units.en: what he compiled, Records of Thirty Kingdoms and Master Quiet Dwelling, circulated in the world.
units.literal: what he compiled, Records of Thirty Kingdoms and Master Quiet Dwelling, circulated in the world.

units.zh: 貞惠世子方諸，字智相，世祖第二子。
units.en: Upright and Gracious Heir Fang Zhu, styled Zhixiang, was Shizu's second son.
units.literal: The Upright and Gracious Heir Fang Zhu, courtesy name Zhixiang, was Emperor Shizu's second son.

units.zh: 母王夫人。
units.en: His mother was Lady Wang.
units.literal: His mother was Lady Wang.

units.zh: 幼聰警博學，明《老》、《易》，善談玄，風采清越，辭辯鋒生，特爲世祖所愛，母王氏又有寵。
units.en: From youth clever and broadly learned, he understood the Laozi and Changes, was skilled in Dark Learning, clear in bearing, sharp in argument—especially loved by Shizu, and his mother Lady Wang also held favor.
units.literal: From youth clever, alert, and broadly learned, he understood the Laozi and Changes, was skilled in Dark Learning discourse, his bearing clear and surpassing, his argument sharp as a blade—he was especially loved by Shizu, and his mother Lady Wang also held favor.

units.zh: 及方等敗沒，世祖謂之曰：「不有所廢，其何以興。」
units.en: When Fang Deng was destroyed Shizu said to him, "Without casting something aside, how can anything rise."
units.literal: When Fang Deng was destroyed Shizu said to him: "Without casting something aside, how can anything rise."

units.zh: 因拜爲中撫軍以自副，又出爲郢州刺史，鎮江夏，以鮑泉爲行事，防遏下流。
units.en: He was made Pacifying Central Army as Shizu's deputy, went out as inspector of E, garrisoned Jiangxia, with Bao Quan as acting officer to block downstream.
units.literal: He was made Pacifying Central Army as Shizu's deputy, went out as inspector of E prefecture, garrisoned Jiangxia, with Bao Quan as acting officer to block the downstream route.

units.zh: 時世祖遣徐文盛督衆軍，與侯景將任約相持未決。
units.en: Shizu sent Xu Wensheng to command armies in stalemate with Hou Jing's general Ren Yue.
units.literal: At the time Shizu sent Xu Wensheng to command the armies in stalemate with Hou Jing's general Ren Yue.

units.zh: 方諸恃文盛在近，不恤軍政，日與鮑泉蒲酒爲樂。
units.en: Fang Zhu relied on Wensheng being near and neglected military affairs, daily drinking with Bao Quan.
units.literal: Fang Zhu relied on Wensheng being near and did not tend military affairs, daily drinking and making merry with Bao Quan.

units.zh: 侯景知之，乃遣其將宋子仙率輕騎數百，從間道襲之。
units.en: Hou Jing learned of it and sent general Song Zixian with several hundred light horse by a bypath to strike.
units.literal: Hou Jing learned of it and sent his general Song Zixian with several hundred light horse by a bypath to strike.

units.zh: 屬風雨晦冥，子仙至，百姓奔告，方諸與鮑泉猶不信，曰：「徐文盛大軍在下，虜安得來？」
units.en: Wind and rain darkened the sky; when Zixian arrived the people ran to report, yet Fang Zhu and Bao Quan still did not believe and said, "Xu Wensheng's great army is below—how could the barbarian come?"
units.literal: Wind and rain made the sky dark; when Zixian arrived the people ran to report, yet Fang Zhu and Bao Quan still did not believe it and said: "Lord Xu Wensheng's great army is below—how could the barbarian come?"

units.zh: 始命閉門，賊騎已入，城遂陷，子仙執方諸以歸。
units.en: Only then were they ordered to shut the gate; bandit horse had already entered and the city fell; Zixian seized Fang Zhu and returned.
units.literal: Only then were they ordered to shut the gate; the bandit horse had already entered and the city fell; Zixian seized Fang Zhu and returned.

units.zh: 王僧辯軍至蔡洲，景遂害之。
units.en: When Wang Sengbian's army reached Cai Isle, Jing killed him.
units.literal: When Wang Sengbian's army reached Cai Isle, Jing then killed him.

units.zh: 世祖追贈侍中、大將軍。
units.en: Shizu posthumously made him palace attendant and grand general.
units.literal: Shizu posthumously made him palace attendant and grand general.

units.zh: 諡曰貞惠世子。
units.en: His posthumous title was Upright and Gracious Heir.
units.literal: His posthumous title was Upright and Gracious Heir.

units.zh: 史臣曰：太宗、世祖諸子，雖開土宇，運屬亂離；
units.en: The historian writes: The sons of Taizong and Shizu, though they opened territories, met chaos and separation;
units.literal: The historian says: The sons of the Heir Apparent Taizong and Emperor Shizu, though they opened territories, met a time of chaos and separation;

units.zh: 旣拘寇賊，多殞非命。
units.en: once seized by bandits, most died untimely deaths.
units.literal: once seized by bandits, most died untimely deaths.

units.zh: 籲！
units.en: Alas!
units.literal: Alas!

units.zh: 可嗟矣。
units.en: Lamentable indeed.
units.literal: Lamentable indeed.

units.zh: 元帝第四子元良為湘州刺史，仍以沖行州事，領長沙內史。
units.en: Yuan's fourth son Yuanliang was inspector of Xiangzhou; Chong again governed the province while serving as interior magistrate of Changsha.
units.literal: Yuan's fourth son Yuanliang was Inspector of Xiangzhou; Chong again conducted the province, concurrently Interior Magistrate of Changsha.

units.zh: 按梁簡文帝長子大器封宣城郡王，見《梁書·哀太子傳》。
units.en: The Book of Liang's biography of the lamented crown prince shows Jianwen's eldest son Daqi enfeoffed as prince of Xuancheng.
units.literal: According to the Biography of the Lamented Crown Prince in the Book of Liang, the eldest son of Emperor Jianwen, Daqi, was enfeoffed as Prince of Xuancheng commandery.

units.zh: 庚午，以司空南康嗣王會理兼尚書令，南海王大臨為揚州刺史，新興王大莊為南徐州刺史。
units.en: On gengwu the heir of Nankang Prince Huili, Minister of Works, also became Director of the Masters of Writing; Prince Dalin of Nanhai became Yangzhou inspector; Prince Dazhuang of Xinxing became South Xuzhou inspector.
units.literal: On gengwu the Heir of Nankang Prince Huili, Minister of Works, additionally became Director of the Masters of Writing; Prince of Nanhai Dalin was made Yangzhou Inspector; Prince of Xinxing Dazhuang was made South Xuzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 遣使害南海王大臨于吳郡，南郡王大連于姑孰，安陸王大春於會稽，新興王大莊於京口。
units.en: Envoys were sent to kill Prince Dailin of Nanhai at Wu, Prince Dalian of Nanjun at Gudu, Prince Dachun of Anlu at Kuaiji, and Prince Dazhuang of Xinxing at Jingkou.
units.literal: Envoys were sent to kill Prince of Nanhai Dailin at Wu commandery, Prince of Nanjun Dalian at Gudu, Prince of Anlu Dachun at Kuaiji, and Prince of Xinxing Dazhuang at Jingkou.

units.zh: 劉神茂自東陽建義拒賊，靈洗攻下新安，與神茂相應。
units.en: Liu Shenmao raised arms at Dongyang against the rebels. Lingxi took Xin'an and acted in concert with him.
units.literal: Liu Shenmao raised righteous arms at Dongyang to resist the rebels; Lingxi took Xin'an and coordinated with Shenmao.

units.zh: 神茂為景所破，景偏帥呂子榮進攻新安，靈洗退保黟、歙。
units.en: Shenmao was defeated by Jing. Jing's lieutenant Lü Zirong pressed Xin'an; Lingxi fell back to Yi and She.
units.literal: Shenmao was broken by Jing; Jing's lieutenant Lü Zirong advanced against Xin'an; Lingxi withdrew to hold Yi and She.

units.zh: 梁世為國子周易生，射策舉高第，除祕書郎、太子舍人、宣惠武陵王主簿、輕車河東王功曹史。
units.en: Under Liang he studied the Book of Changes at the national university, took top marks in the archery-and-writing examination, and served as secretary, mentor to the heir apparent, personal secretary to the Prince of Wuling of Xuanhui, and records officer to the Prince of Hedong.
units.literal: In Liang he was a National University student in the Book of Changes, scored highest in the archery-and-writing examination, appointed Secretary, Mentor to the Heir Apparent, personal secretary to the Prince of Wuling of Xuanhui, and Records Officer to the Prince of Hedong.

units.zh: 時河東王為廣州刺史，乃以勱為冠軍河東王長史、南海太守。
units.en: At that time the Prince of Hedong was inspector of Guangzhou; Mo was made his chief clerk, champion, and administrator of Nanhai.
units.literal: At the time the Prince of Hedong was Inspector of Guangzhou; Mo was made Chief Clerk to the Prince of Hedong, Champion, and Administrator of Nanhai.

units.zh: 王至嶺南，多所侵掠，因懼罪稱疾，委州還朝，勱行廣州府事。
units.en: The prince reached Lingnan and plundered widely; fearing punishment he pleaded illness, handed back the province, and returned to court, leaving Mo to run Guangzhou affairs.
units.literal: The prince reached Lingnan and there greatly plundered; fearing guilt he claimed illness, entrusted the province and returned to court; Mo conducted Guangzhou establishment affairs.

units.zh: 起家梁祕書郎，歷太子舍人，輕車河東王主簿，安前邵陵王、中軍宣
units.en: He began as a Liang secretariat gentleman, then served as crown prince aide, registrar to the prince of Hedong of the light chariots, and merit clerk in the households of the former prince of Shaoling and the central army prince Xuan
units.literal: He first entered office as a Liang Secretariat Gentleman, then served as Aide to the Crown Prince, Registrar to the Prince of Hedong of the Light Chariots, and Merit Clerk in the two prefectures of the preceding Prince of Shaoling and the Central Army Prince Xuan

units.zh: 褚修華生建平王大球。
units.en: Chu Xiuhua bore Prince Daqiu of Jianping.
units.literal: Chu Xiuhua bore Prince Daqiu of Jianping.

units.zh: 紹京嗜書畫，如王義之、獻之、褚遂良真跡，藏家者至數十百卷。
units.en: Shaojing loved calligraphy and painting; households that owned authentic pieces by Wang Xizhi, Wang Xianzhi, or Chu Suiliang might hold dozens or even hundreds of scrolls.
units.literal: Shaojing was fond of calligraphy and painting; authentic works of Wang Xizhi, Wang Xianzhi, and Chu Suiliang in collectors' homes might reach scores or hundreds of scrolls.

units.zh: 立皇子大鈞為西陽郡王，大威為武寧郡王，大球為建安郡王，大昕為義安郡王，大摯為綏建郡王，大圜為樂梁郡王。
units.en: The princes Dagun, Dawei, Daqiu, Daxin, Dazhi, and Dayuan were enfeoffed as princes of Xiyang, Wuning, Jian'an, Yi'an, Suijian, and Yuele commanderies.
units.literal: Imperial sons Dagun, Dawei, Daqiu, Daxin, Dazhi, and Dayuan were enfeoffed as princes of Xiyang, Wuning, Jian'an, Yi'an, Suijian, and Yuele commanderies.

units.zh: 時綸長史韋質、司馬薑律先在于外，聞綸敗，馳往迎之。
units.en: At that time Xiao Lun's chief clerk Wei Zhi and marshal Jiang Lu were already abroad; hearing of his defeat they raced to meet him.
units.literal: At that time Xiao Lun's chief clerk Wei Zhi and marshal Jiang Lu were already abroad; hearing of Xiao Lun's defeat they raced to meet him.

units.zh: 壬辰，封當陽公大心為尋陽郡王，石城公大款為江夏郡王，寧國公大臨為南海郡王，臨城公大連為南郡王，西豊公大春為安陸郡王，新塗公大成為山陽郡王，臨湘公大封為宜都郡王。
units.en: On renchen Duke Daxin of Dangyang became Prince of Xunyang, Duke Dakuan of Shicheng Prince of Jiangxia, Duke Dalin of Ningguo Prince of Nanhai, Duke Dalian of Lincheng Prince of Nan commandery, Duke Dachun of Xifeng Prince of Anlu, Duke Dacheng of Xintu Prince of Shanyang, and Duke Dafeng of Linxiang Prince of Yidu.
units.literal: On renchen Duke of Dangyang Daxin was enfeoffed as Prince of Xunyang commandery, Duke of Shicheng Dakuan as Prince of Jiangxia, Duke of Ningguo Dalin as Prince of Nanhai, Duke of Lincheng Dalian as Prince of Nan commandery, Duke of Xifeng Dachun as Prince of Anlu, Duke of Xintu Dacheng as Prince of Shanyang, Duke of Linxiang Dafeng as Prince of Yidu.

units.zh: 害皇太子大器、尋陽王大心、西陽王大鈞、武寧王大威、建平王大球、義安王大昕及尋陽王諸子二十人。
units.en: He killed Crown Prince Daqi, the princes of Xunyang, Xiyang, Wuning, Jianping, and Yi'an, and twenty sons of the Prince of Xunyang.
units.literal: He killed Crown Prince Daqi, Prince of Xunyang Daxin, Prince of Xiyang Dajun, Prince of Wuning Dawei, Prince of Jianping Daqiu, Prince of Yi'an Daxin, and twenty sons of the Prince of Xunyang.

units.zh: 包昭華生西陽王大鈞。
units.en: Bao Zhaohua bore Prince Dajun of Xiyang.
units.literal: Bao Zhaohua bore Prince Dajun of Xiyang.

units.zh: 會鐵據豫章反，大心令中兵參軍韋約討之，鐵敗乞降。
units.en: When Tie rebelled and held Yuzhang, Daxin sent Wei Yue to attack; Tie was defeated and begged to surrender.
units.literal: When Tie seized Yuzhang and rebelled, Daxin sent the Central Army Major Wei Yue to attack him; Tie was defeated and begged to surrender.

units.zh: 乃遣將侯瑱救鐵，夜破韋約等營。
units.en: He sent Hou Zhen to rescue Tie, who by night smashed Wei Yue's camp.
units.literal: He then sent the general Hou Zhen to rescue Tie, who by night broke Wei Yue's camp.
